cases.head: 4d782b8aa68a9ddf5b673207d262bbae66f4e28b
cases.rationale: Canonical object order should survive the sorting change. The saved small-object check does not exercise the fallback after many insertion-sort moves.

cases.head: dde34e05a12960a5f6655a61e5af33233c6aa1c7
cases.rationale: Default canonical ordering is a useful control for the new custom comparator option. The saved experiment has no custom comparator.

cases.head: 2272d6040530e8c84b7d8f779fa5611cf4afb0d0
cases.rationale: The replaced GraphQL request key serializer sorts object properties and retains array element order, the two behaviors checked by the saved cache-key experiment.

cases.head: 7928e765b0d7c190f469b22c8a2efb559ec147b1
cases.rationale: The changed scalar path uses a custom toJSON result. Plain objects and arrays do not exercise it.

cases.head: 7c6fa00cacc71616c82d7494773f36ff78853798
cases.rationale: The change removes duplicate stringification in the SSR exchange. The saved replay has neither per-result serialization calls nor the urql SSR exchange.

cases.head: bf4a52d936dcf083507d4462b244e91d8b7777a0
cases.rationale: Preserving filtered rows is relevant to predicate pruning. The saved Parquet fixture cannot exercise page index bounds that are incomparable with the predicate.

cases.head: 9813f4aa04969b6710a33582d0ace879254abfca
cases.rationale: The reader reconstructs struct validity when requested children are missing. The saved nested filter workload has no absent child projection or top-level validity assertion.

cases.head: b82e58c85f3542292f87c6896a80021f3ef0bdd2
cases.rationale: The change is in writer-side statistics aggregation and needs floating-point NaN inputs. The saved fixture measures reader pushdown with integer fields.

cases.head: b72875d12380d01ad858377ef0a20de34280aff1
cases.rationale: Ordinary subscription and unsubscribe behavior is a useful control for listener queues. The saved test lacks reentrant unbind and grouped writes.

cases.head: e5b73e38c428b5cfa5047c9d89f129ed7993d272
cases.rationale: The change compares watched deep paths during whole-store set. The saved store checks have no path-filtered subscriptions.

cases.head: 138f1aa5f09905f0adf32617c30dae7c18c35abd
cases.rationale: The issue is a React subscription timing path during synchronous onMount updates. The saved vanilla check has no React lifecycle.

cases.head: b05987792578358fbf593ff9612d6b4ed345fb11
cases.rationale: Ordinary notifications are a control for the vanilla store callback refactor. The saved experiment has no dependent atoms or nested callback flushes.
